title: Pluggable
description: A part Danbyte seats in a port or a rack unit, in `danbyte/pluggables/<Vendor>/<NAME>.yaml` (a pack's `accessory-types/`): transceivers, plugs and cords (export spec §13), and rack parts: blanking panels, cable managers, shelves (§14). Danbyte draws the part at a port's `port:` anchor while the port is cabled or a transceiver is recorded in it, and picks one by `fits` (the port type), `parts` (the recorded part number) and `connector` (the cable's medium).

name.description: The part's name: the vendor part number for a real part (`SFP-10G-SR`), the common name in capitals for a generic one (`RJ45-PLUG`). Equals the file name.

kind.description: transceiver (a module in a cage, with a `port:<connector>` empty a cord seats in), plug or cord (a cable end; cord = one-piece parts such as DACs and stack cables), or a rack part: blanking, cable-manager, shelf.

connector.description: The connector it presents or is: `rj45`, `lc`, `sc`, `mpo`, `c13` / `c15` / `c19` (IEC cords), `dac` / `aoc` (one-piece cables), `stack` (stack cable heads, chosen by `fits`). Danbyte groups parts by medium from it: lc/sc/mpo… fibre, dac/twinax DAC, rj45 copper. A cord seats at a transceiver's `port:<connector>` empty when the connectors match.

fits.description: The port types (NetBox interface, console or power port type slugs, or Danbyte extension types such as `cisco-stackpower`) it plugs into. Required for every kind but rack parts.

parts.description: Every vendor part number this model stands for, as printed on the label and as switches report them (`SFP-10G-SR`, not `SFP-10G-SR=`; a trailing `=` is ignored). Empty for a generic fallback.

standard.description: The IEEE / MSA name (`10GBASE-SR`, `100GBASE-SR4`, `1000BASE-T`), or the stack system for stack cables.

wavelength_nm.description: Nominal wavelength in nm; leave it out for copper.

u_height.description: Rack parts only: height in rack units, 0 for a vertical (0U) part such as a 2-post vertical cable manager. (Danbyte's importer in 0.21 takes 1-10 and refuses 0.)

comments.description: What the model shows and where its sizes come from.

model3d.description: The part's model: origin where the plug meets the port, +Z out of the port, +Y up; a cord's run continues from its `cable` empty. Budgets: transceiver ≤ 1,500 triangles, plug or cord ≤ 2,000, rack part ≤ 5,000; ≤ 200 KB (rack parts ≤ 8 MB). No far copy.

renders.description: Photos of the part, for the catalog. Danbyte doesn't import them.

cable.description: How Danbyte draws a cord's run from its `cable` empty to the other end (export spec §13): one round jacket, a zip cord (two side by side) or a ribbon (several side by side, along the empty's local X), with corners no tighter than the minimum bend radius where there is room.

profile.description: round, zipcord (two jackets) or ribbon (count jackets).

pitch_mm.description: Zip cord and ribbon: centre to centre, mm; no narrower than the jacket.

min_bend_mm.description: Minimum bend radius, mm (the default for every length).

min_bend_by_part.description: Part number → minimum bend radius (mm), where one length needs more than `min_bend_mm`. Keys should be listed in `parts`.
